title: LSTM features for the meta model
hypothesis: LSTM-learned features or a vol forecaster lift the meta model.
question: Does an LSTM encoder (features) or an LSTM vol forecaster (barrier widths) improve the meta overlay?
prior: Sequence models can learn representations hand-built features miss.
citations: Hochreiter, S. & Schmidhuber, J. (1997). Long Short-Term Memory. Neural Computation 9(8).
method: LSTM pretrained on the price history, outputs fed to the champion meta model.
verdict_reason: It showed a small lift (Sharpe 1.226 → 1.242), but the LSTM was pretrained on data that included the evaluation period. v37 removed that look-ahead and the lift vanished.
lessons: Every learned component, including pretraining, must be trained only on data before each decision.
footer: Research code is private; methods summarised below.
